query: INSERT INTO sync_remote_entries (user_id, provider, external_id, title, status, progress, content_type, start_year, updated_at, series_id, fetched_at) SELECT DISTINCT ON (external_id) $1, $2, external_id, title, status, progress, content_type, CASE WHEN year_present THEN start_year END, updated_at, CASE WHEN series_present THEN series_id END, now() FROM UNNEST($3::text[], $4::text[], $5::text[], $6::float8[], $7::text[], $8::int4[], $9::bool[], $10::timestamptz[], $11::uuid[], $12::bool[]) AS t(external_id, title, status, progress, content_type, start_year, year_present, updated_at, series_id, series_present) ON CONFLICT (user_id, provider, external_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, status = EXCLUDED.status, progress = EXCLUDED.progress, content_type = EXCLUDED.content_type, start_year = EXCLUDED.start_year, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, series_id = EXCLUDED.series_id, fetched_at = now()
